pose_en: She stands upright, seen from the side, facing left, rising as HIGH as possible onto the balls of BOTH feet: both heels are lifted far off the floor (a clear gap of about 8 cm under each heel), knees straight, arms relaxed beside her body. Her right foot is slightly in front of the left, ready to step. The arrow is a straight horizontal arrow on the floor just in front of her toes, pointing FORWARD (to the left), showing her walking forward on tiptoe.
eind_en: END position: she has taken one step forward to the left and is still walking high on her toes: the right foot is now clearly in front, BOTH heels stay high off the floor, knees straight, arms swinging lightly. Both figures seen from the side, facing left.
extra_avatar: CLOSE-UP framing from the knees down, seen from the side. TOP: standing with both heels flat on the floor. BOTTOM: walking a step forward HIGH on the tips of the toes, both heels lifted far off the floor (clearly visible gap under the heels).

naam: Kuit laten zakken op een verhoging – excentrisch
pose_en: Frame her from the hips down, seen exactly from the side, facing left, with her left hand resting on a wall on the left for balance (hand and forearm visible at the top edge). She stands on the edge of a low wooden step: ONLY the ball of her RIGHT foot is on the back edge of the step and she is risen HIGH onto her toes, heel far above the edge, right knee straight. Her LEFT foot is lifted off the step and bent back behind her. The arrow is a curved arrow at the back of her right heel pointing DOWN, below the level of the step, showing the heel being lowered slowly.
eind_en: END position: same framing and view, still standing on the right foot only with the left foot lifted behind, but now the right HEEL has dropped slowly DOWN well BELOW the edge of the step (the ankle fully bent upward), right knee still straight, hand on the wall.
extra_avatar: CLOSE-UP framing from the knees down, seen from the side, the edge of the step clearly visible. TOP: standing on the ball of the foot on the step edge with the heel lifted HIGH (on tiptoe). BOTTOM: the heel has been lowered slowly far BELOW the level of the step. The difference in heel height must be obvious.

pose_en: Frame her from the knees down plus the front of the chair seat, seen in a THREE-QUARTER FRONT view so the right foot is large and clearly visible. She sits on a chair, the right leg stretched forward with the heel just off the floor, the right foot pointing straight UP (toes toward the ceiling); the left foot rests flat on the floor. The arrow is a looping curved arrow drawn in the air just in front of the right big toe, shaped like a handwritten capital letter, showing the toe tracing letters while the lower leg stays still.
eind_en: END position: same framing and view, the right lower leg still in the same place, but the right foot is now turned clearly INWARD and pointed DOWN (toes toward the floor and toward the other foot), as if halfway through drawing a letter.
extra_avatar: CLOSE-UP from the knees down, three-quarter front view. TOP: right foot points straight up. BOTTOM: the same foot is strongly turned inward and pointed down. The shin stays in exactly the same place in both figures; only the ankle moves. Exaggerate the foot position difference.

naam: Voetzool rekken – tenen tegen de muur
pose_en: Frame her from the hips down, seen exactly from the side, facing left, with a wall on the LEFT edge of the picture. She is barefoot. Her RIGHT foot is in front, close to the wall: the heel is on the floor and the toes and ball of the foot are pressed UP against the wall (toes bent back), the right knee straight. Her left foot stands flat on the floor a small step behind. Her hands rest on the wall at waist height. The arrow is a curved arrow at the front of her right knee pointing FORWARD toward the wall, showing the knee being bent toward the wall.
eind_en: END position: same framing and view, barefoot, the right toes still up against the wall and the right heel still on the floor, but now the right KNEE is clearly bent and pushed forward almost touching the wall.
extra_avatar: Frame both figures from the hips down, exactly from the side, wall on the left, barefoot. In BOTH figures the right toes are pressed up against the wall and the right heel stays on the floor. TOP: right knee straight. BOTTOM: right knee strongly bent forward, close to the wall. Exaggerate the knee bend.

naam: Eenbenige kniebuiging – en op de tenen komen
pose_en: She stands on her RIGHT leg only, seen from the side, facing left. The right knee is bent about 30 degrees in a small one-leg squat with the whole right foot flat on the floor; the left foot is lifted off the floor with the left knee bent behind her. Both arms are spread out to the sides at shoulder height for balance. The arrow is a straight arrow beside her right heel pointing UP, showing her rising up out of the squat onto her toes.
eind_en: END position: still standing on the right leg only, left foot lifted behind, arms spread; the right knee is now fully straight and she is risen HIGH onto the ball of the right foot, the right heel clearly off the floor.
extra_avatar: Seen from the side, framed from the hips down. TOP: standing tall on one leg, knee straight. BOTTOM: on the same leg the knee is clearly BENT (about 45 degrees) in a single-leg mini squat, heel lifted, the other foot off the floor.

pose_en: She stands upright on her RIGHT leg only, seen from the side, facing left, the right knee straight and the right foot flat on the floor; the left foot is lifted just off the floor with the left knee slightly bent. Both arms hang straight beside her body. The arrow is a straight arrow beside her right hip pointing DOWN, showing her bending the standing knee into a half squat.
eind_en: END position: still on the right leg only, the right knee is clearly bent in a half squat over the toes with the right heel flat on the floor, hips pushed back; at the same time the elbows are bent 90 degrees like a runner: the LEFT arm swung forward and the RIGHT arm swung back.
extra_avatar: Seen from the side. Standing on ONE leg in both figures (the other foot stays off the floor - she does NOT run or step). TOP: standing tall on one leg, arms by the sides. BOTTOM: the standing knee is clearly bent in a single-leg squat and the opposite arm swings forward at shoulder height.

pose_en: She is seen in a THREE-QUARTER FRONT view from slightly above, so a large X made of two crossing strips of tape on the floor is clearly visible in front of her. She stands on her RIGHT leg only in the back-left quarter of the X, the right knee slightly bent, the left foot lifted behind her, arms slightly spread for balance. The arrow is a curved arc from her right foot jumping diagonally FORWARD and to the RIGHT over the crossing tape line into the opposite (front-right) quarter of the X.
eind_en: END position: same view, she has hopped diagonally and has landed on her RIGHT foot only in the front-right quarter of the tape X, right knee softly bent, left foot still lifted, arms slightly spread.
extra_avatar: Show the tape X on the floor clearly in both figures. TOP: on the right foot in the back-left quarter. BOTTOM: on the right foot in the front-right quarter, diagonally across the line. Always one leg only, the left foot lifted.

naam: Voet voor voet lopen – met hoofd draaien
pose_en: She is seen in a THREE-QUARTER FRONT view, walking toward the viewer along a straight line of tape on the floor. Her feet are heel-to-toe on the line: the RIGHT foot directly in front of the left, the right heel touching the left toes. Her arms are slightly spread for balance. Her head is turned clearly to HER LEFT while her eyes stay on a point straight ahead. The arrow is a curved horizontal arrow around the front of her head, from her left side to her right side, showing the head turning from left to right.
eind_en: END position: same view, one step further along the tape line, now the LEFT foot directly in front of the right (heel touching toes), and her head is turned clearly to HER RIGHT; arms still slightly spread.
extra_avatar: Show the tape line and the heel-to-toe feet clearly. TOP: head turned to her left. BOTTOM: head turned to her right, one step further along the line. The feet are always exactly in one line, heel touching toes.

pose_en: She stands on her RIGHT leg only, seen from the FRONT, leaning very slightly forward, hands on her hips. Her LEFT leg is straight and swung out to HER LEFT side (to the viewer's right), the left foot about 30 cm off the floor. The arrow is a curved arrow at the left foot sweeping across IN FRONT of the standing right leg toward her right side, showing the leg swinging across.
eind_en: END position: seen from the front, still on the right leg with hands on the hips, the straight left leg has swung across IN FRONT of the right leg and now points diagonally to HER RIGHT side (the viewer's left), the left foot off the floor.
extra_avatar: Both figures seen from the front, hands on hips, standing on the right leg only. TOP: left leg out to her left. BOTTOM: left leg crossed in front of the right leg toward her right. The left foot never touches the floor.

naam: Huppelen op de voorvoeten – gestrekte knieën
pose_en: She stands seen from the side, facing left, high on the balls of BOTH feet with both heels lifted well off the floor, knees almost straight, arms slightly bent at her sides. The arrow is a small curved arc starting at her toes going UP and FORWARD (to the left), showing a small quick bounce forward from the ankles.
eind_en: END position: in the air a few centimetres above the floor and slightly further to the left, both knees still almost straight, both feet pointed with the toes down, arms slightly bent.
extra_avatar: CLOSE-UP framing from the hips down, seen from the side. TOP: standing on the balls of both feet, knees straight. BOTTOM: both feet clearly in the AIR a few centimetres above the floor during a small hop, knees still straight, toes pointing down.

naam: Voetzool rekken – tenen naar je toe trekken
pose_en: Frame her from the waist down, seen from the FRONT at a slight angle so the sole of the foot is visible. She sits on a chair, barefoot, with her RIGHT ankle resting on her LEFT knee (figure-four position), the sole of the right foot turned toward the viewer. Her left hand holds the right ankle and the fingers of her right hand are wrapped over the right toes, the toes still relaxed and straight. The arrow is a curved arrow at the right toes pointing BACK toward the shin, showing the toes being pulled back.
eind_en: END position: same framing and view, barefoot, right ankle still on the left knee, the right hand now pulls the toes, especially the big toe, far BACK toward the shin so the arch of the foot is clearly stretched.
extra_avatar: CLOSE-UP on the right foot and both hands, from the waist down, barefoot, five fingers on each hand and five toes. TOP: toes straight and relaxed. BOTTOM: toes bent far back toward the shin, the arch visibly stretched.

naam: Voetzool rollen – over een koude fles
pose_en: Frame her from the knees down plus the front of the chair seat, seen exactly from the side, facing left. She sits on a chair, the RIGHT foot bare and resting on a plastic water bottle lying sideways on the floor (the bottle at right angles to the foot), the bottle under the BALL of the foot. The left foot rests flat on the floor. The arrow is a straight horizontal arrow along the top of the right foot pointing FORWARD (to the left), showing the foot rolling forward over the bottle.
eind_en: END position: same framing and view, the right foot has rolled forward over the bottle so the bottle now lies under the HEEL of the foot; the knee is a little more stretched.
extra_avatar: CLOSE-UP from the knees down, exactly from the side, barefoot right foot, the bottle clearly visible. TOP: bottle under the ball of the foot. BOTTOM: foot moved forward, bottle under the heel.

naam: Voet naar binnen en omlaag – met elastiek, been over de knie
pose_en: Frame her from the waist down, seen from the FRONT. She sits on a chair with her RIGHT ankle resting on her LEFT knee (figure-four position). A resistance band loops around the front of the right forefoot and both ends are held in her right hand ABOVE the foot, the band taut. The right foot is pulled up (toes toward the shin). The arrow is a curved arrow at the right toes pointing DOWN and inward, showing the foot pushing down and turning in against the band.
eind_en: END position: same framing and view, the right ankle still on the left knee, the right foot is now pointed DOWN (toes away from the shin) and turned IN so the sole faces up toward the ceiling, the band stretched tighter from the forefoot to her right hand.
extra_avatar: CLOSE-UP from the waist down, front view, band clearly visible. TOP: foot pulled up toward the shin. BOTTOM: foot strongly pointed down and turned in, sole facing up, band stretched. The shin stays on the knee in both. Exaggerate the foot difference.

naam: Knie naar voren over voet – met elastiek om de enkel
pose_en: Frame her from the hips down, seen exactly from the side, facing left. She stands in a small step position, the RIGHT foot in front, with her hands resting on the back of a chair in front of her (left). A resistance band loops around the FRONT of her right ankle and runs straight BACKWARD (to the right) to an anchor low on a post behind her, the band taut. The right knee is straight above the ankle, right heel flat on the floor. The arrow is a curved arrow at the front of the right knee pointing FORWARD over the toes.
eind_en: END position: same framing and view, the right KNEE is now bent and pushed far FORWARD over the right toes, the right heel still flat on the floor, the band pulled taut from the front of the ankle back to the anchor.
extra_avatar: Frame both figures from the hips down, exactly from the side, band and anchor clearly visible behind her. TOP: right shin vertical. BOTTOM: right knee far forward beyond the toes, heel still down. Exaggerate the forward knee movement.

pose_en: She stands upright, seen from the side, facing left, feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with the arms hanging straight beside her body. The arrow is a curved arrow at her left foot pointing BACKWARD (to the right) and DOWN, showing the left leg stepping far back into a lunge.
eind_en: END position: the left leg has stepped far back to the right; both knees are bent about 90 degrees, the right (front) thigh horizontal with the right heel flat on the floor, the left knee just above the floor on the toes of the left foot; back straight, dumbbells still hanging beside her body.
extra_avatar: Both figures from the side, facing left. BOTTOM: a deep backward lunge, the LEFT leg behind, the RIGHT leg in front. Dumbbells in both hands in both figures.

pose_en: She lies on her RIGHT side on an exercise mat, seen from the front, head to the viewer's LEFT, propped up on her right forearm. A foam roller lies crosswise under the OUTER side of her right lower leg, just below the knee; the right leg is straight. Her left leg is bent with the left foot flat on the mat in front of the right knee for support. The arrow is a straight arrow along her body pointing toward her head (to the left), showing her body sliding so the roller moves down the lower leg toward the ankle.
eind_en: END position: same view, she has pushed her body toward the head side so the foam roller now lies under the outer side of the right lower leg just ABOVE the ankle; still on the right forearm, left foot flat on the mat.
extra_avatar: Both figures lying on the right side with the roller under the OUTER side of the right lower leg. TOP: roller just below the knee. BOTTOM: roller just above the ankle. Never on the calf or the thigh.

pose_en: Frame her from the hips down, seen exactly from the side. She lies on her BACK on an exercise mat with both legs straight, her feet on the LEFT side of the picture. Both feet are pulled strongly UP toward her (toes pointing up toward the ceiling and back toward her head). The arrow is a curved arrow at the toes of the near (right) foot pointing AWAY from her, forward and down, showing the feet being pushed away.
eind_en: END position: same framing and view, legs still straight and flat on the mat, both feet now pushed far AWAY from her, toes pointing away along the line of the legs like a ballerina.
extra_avatar: CLOSE-UP of the lower legs and feet only, lying on the back, seen from the side, barefoot. TOP: the feet pulled UP toward the shins, toes pointing to the ceiling/toward her. BOTTOM: the feet pushed far DOWN, toes pointing away like a ballerina. The difference in foot angle must be obvious.

naam: Voeten naar buiten en binnen rollen – met elastiek
pose_en: Frame her from the knees down, seen from the FRONT. She sits on a chair, barefoot, both feet flat on the floor about hip-width apart, a looped resistance band around both forefeet, pulled taut between the feet. The arrow is a curved arrow under the inner arch of the right foot pointing UP and outward, showing the feet rolling onto their outer edges.
eind_en: END position: same framing and view, barefoot, both feet have rolled onto their OUTER edges so the inner arches are lifted high off the floor and the soles partly face each other, the band stretched tighter between the feet, toes still gripping the floor.
extra_avatar: CLOSE-UP from the knees down, front view, barefoot, band clearly visible. TOP: both feet flat. BOTTOM: both feet tilted onto their outer edges, arches clearly lifted. Exaggerate the tilt.

pose_en: CLOSE-UP framing: show her from the knees down plus the front edge of the chair seat, seen from the FRONT. She sits on a plain chair, both feet flat on the floor, hip-width apart, both feet pointing straight forward. The arrow is a short curved arrow on the floor at the toes of her RIGHT foot (the foot on the viewer's left), curving OUTWARD, away from the other foot, showing the forefoot swinging outward while the heel stays in place on the floor.
eind_en: END position: same close-up front view. The right heel is still on the floor in the same spot, but the right forefoot has turned clearly OUTWARD (toes pointing about 40 degrees away from the other foot). The right knee has not moved. Left foot unchanged, flat and pointing forward.
extra_avatar: EXTREME CLOSE-UP of the right lower leg and foot only (from the knee down), seen from the front, barefoot, the heel resting on the floor. TOP: the foot straight, toes pointing up. BOTTOM: the foot clearly rotated OUTWARD (sole turning out, little toe side up); the knee and shin do not move. The difference must be obvious.

pose_en: CLOSE-UP framing: show her from the knees down plus the front edge of the chair seat, seen from the FRONT. She sits on a plain chair, both feet flat on the floor, a little wider than hip-width apart, both feet pointing straight forward. The arrow is a short curved arrow on the floor at the toes of her RIGHT foot (the foot on the viewer's left), curving INWARD, toward the other foot, showing the forefoot swinging inward while the heel stays in place on the floor.
eind_en: END position: same close-up front view. The right heel is still on the floor in the same spot, but the right forefoot has turned clearly INWARD (toes pointing about 35 degrees toward the left foot). The right knee has not moved. Left foot unchanged.
extra_avatar: EXTREME CLOSE-UP of the right lower leg and foot only (from the knee down), seen from the front, barefoot, the heel resting on the floor. TOP: the foot straight, toes pointing up. BOTTOM: the foot clearly rotated INWARD (sole turning in toward the other foot, big toe side up); the knee and shin do not move. The difference must be obvious.

pose_en: CLOSE-UP framing: show her from the knees down plus the front of the chair seat, seen exactly from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right), so her right leg is nearest to the viewer. She sits on a plain chair with both feet FLAT on the floor, knees bent at a right angle. The arrow is a short curved arrow at the toes of her right foot pointing UP, showing the forefoot being lifted while the heel stays on the floor.
eind_en: END position: same close-up side view. The right heel is still on the floor, but the right forefoot and toes are lifted HIGH off the floor (the sole of the forefoot clearly visible, foot tilted up about 30 degrees). Left foot still flat.
extra_avatar: EXTREME CLOSE-UP of the right lower leg and foot from the knee down, seen from the side, barefoot, the heel on the floor. TOP: foot flat on the floor. BOTTOM: the forefoot and toes pulled HIGH up toward the shin, only the heel touches the floor.

pose_en: CLOSE-UP framing: show her from the knees down plus the front of the chair seat, seen exactly from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right), so her right leg is nearest to the viewer. She sits on a plain chair. Her RIGHT leg is stretched a little forward, the knee almost straight, the right heel resting on the floor and the foot upright (toes pointing up to the ceiling). Her left foot is flat on the floor under the knee. The arrow is a curved arrow at the right toes going FORWARD and DOWN, showing the foot being pushed away like pressing a gas pedal.
eind_en: END position: same close-up side view. The right heel is still on the floor in the same spot, but the right foot is now pointed far FORWARD and DOWN, the sole and toes pressed toward the floor, the instep in one line with the shin.
extra_avatar: CLOSE-UP from the knees down, seen from the side. TOP: right leg stretched forward, heel on the floor, toes pointing UP. BOTTOM: the same foot pushed DOWN and away like pressing a pedal, toes near the floor. The lower leg stays in the same place. Exaggerate the difference.

pose_en: Frame her from the hips down, seen exactly from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right), so her right leg is nearest to the viewer, her hand resting on a wall in front of her (on the viewer's right) for balance. She stands on a low wooden step with ONLY the balls of BOTH feet on the back edge of the step; both heels stick out over the edge and hang just BELOW the level of the step, knees straight. The arrow is a straight arrow at the back of her right heel pointing UP, showing her pushing up onto her toes.
eind_en: END position: same framing and view. She has risen HIGH onto the balls of both feet on the step edge: both heels are lifted far ABOVE the level of the step, knees straight, hand still on the wall.
extra_avatar: CLOSE-UP from the knees down, seen from the side, the step clearly visible. TOP: standing on the step edge with the heels lowered below the step. BOTTOM: standing HIGH on tiptoe on the step, heels lifted far up.

pose_en: Frame her from the hips down, seen exactly from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right), so her right leg is nearest to the viewer. A plain chair stands in front of her and one hand rests lightly on its backrest. She stands ONLY on her RIGHT foot, flat on the floor, right knee straight; her LEFT foot is lifted off the floor and bent back behind her. The arrow is a straight arrow at the back of her right heel pointing UP, showing her rising onto her toes on one leg.
eind_en: END position: same framing and view, still standing only on the right leg with the left foot lifted behind. She has risen HIGH onto the ball of the right foot: the right heel is far off the floor, right knee straight.
extra_avatar: CLOSE-UP from the knees down, seen from the side. In BOTH figures only the right foot touches the floor. TOP: right foot flat. BOTTOM: high on the toes of the right foot, a big clear gap under the heel.

naam: Kuitrek gestrekte knie – staand met steun
pose_en: She stands facing a wall, seen exactly from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right), so her right leg is nearest to the viewer, the wall on the viewer's right. Both hands rest flat on the wall at chest height, arms almost straight. Her LEFT foot is close to the wall; her RIGHT leg is placed a big step BACK, the right knee completely straight and the right heel flat on the floor, toes pointing to the wall. Her body is still upright. The arrow is a straight horizontal arrow at her hips pointing FORWARD toward the wall, showing the hips moving forward.
eind_en: END position: same side view. Her hips have moved FORWARD toward the wall and the front (left) knee is bent; the back (right) leg is still completely STRAIGHT with the heel flat on the floor, so the body and back leg form one long slanted line. Elbows slightly bent, hands on the wall.
extra_avatar: Seen from the side, wall on the right. In BOTH figures the back (right) knee is straight and the right heel is on the floor. TOP: body upright, arms long. BOTTOM: hips shifted far forward, front knee bent, the straight back leg slanted.

pose_en: CLOSE-UP framing from the knees down to the feet. She sits on an exercise mat with her right leg stretched straight in front of her, seen in a three-quarter view from her feet, so the sole and toes of the RIGHT foot are large and clearly visible; the foot is upright, toes pointing to the ceiling. An elastic band is looped around her right forefoot and runs sideways to an anchor on a table leg at the OUTER side of the foot (her right side, away from the other leg). The arrow is a curved arrow at the right toes going INWARD, toward the other leg, showing the foot turning inward against the band.
eind_en: END position: same close-up view. The right lower leg has not moved, but the right foot is turned clearly INWARD: the sole faces the other leg and the toes point inward, the elastic band stretched tight toward the anchor on the outer side.
extra_avatar: CLOSE-UP of the lower leg and foot. The band anchor is on the OUTER side of the right foot. TOP: foot upright, toes to the ceiling. BOTTOM: foot turned strongly INWARD (sole toward the other leg), band taut. The shin and knee do not rotate. Exaggerate the difference.

pose_en: CLOSE-UP framing from the knees down to the feet. She sits on an exercise mat with her right leg stretched straight in front of her, seen in a three-quarter view from her feet, so the sole and toes of the RIGHT foot are large and clearly visible; the foot is upright, toes pointing to the ceiling. An elastic band is looped around her right forefoot and runs sideways across to an anchor on a table leg at the INNER side of the foot (her left side, beyond the other leg). The arrow is a curved arrow at the right toes going OUTWARD, away from the other leg, showing the foot turning outward against the band.
eind_en: END position: same close-up view. The right lower leg has not moved, but the right foot is turned clearly OUTWARD: the sole faces away from the other leg and the little-toe side is pulled up and out, the elastic band stretched tight toward the anchor on the inner side.
extra_avatar: CLOSE-UP of the lower leg and foot. The band anchor is on the INNER side (beyond the other leg). TOP: foot upright, toes to the ceiling. BOTTOM: foot turned strongly OUTWARD (toes pointing away from the other leg), band taut. The shin and knee do not rotate. Exaggerate the difference.

naam: Kuitrek gestrekte knie – op een verhoging
pose_en: Frame her from the hips down, seen exactly from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right), so her right leg is nearest to the viewer, her hand resting on a wall in front of her (on the viewer's right) for balance. She stands on a low wooden step. Her LEFT foot stands completely on the step. ONLY the ball of her RIGHT foot is on the back edge of the step, the right heel sticking out over the edge at the SAME level as the step, right knee completely straight. The arrow is a curved arrow at the back of her right heel pointing DOWN, below the level of the step, showing the heel being lowered.
eind_en: END position: same framing and view. The right heel has dropped far BELOW the edge of the step, the right knee still completely STRAIGHT, the calf visibly stretched. Left foot still on the step, hand on the wall.
extra_avatar: CLOSE-UP from the knees down, seen from the side, step edge clearly visible. In BOTH figures the right knee is straight. TOP: right heel level with the step. BOTTOM: right heel sunk far BELOW the step edge. The difference in heel height must be obvious.

naam: Kuitrek gebogen knie – op een verhoging
pose_en: Frame her from the hips down, seen exactly from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right), so her right leg is nearest to the viewer, her hand resting on a wall in front of her (on the viewer's right) for balance. She stands on a low wooden step. Her LEFT foot stands completely on the step. ONLY the ball of her RIGHT foot is on the back edge of the step, the right heel sticking out over the edge at the same level as the step, right knee straight. The arrow is a curved arrow at the back of her right heel pointing DOWN, below the level of the step, showing the heel being lowered while the knee bends.
eind_en: END position: same framing and view. The right KNEE is now clearly BENT (about 25 degrees, the knee pushed forward) and the right heel has dropped BELOW the edge of the step. Left foot still on the step, hand on the wall.
extra_avatar: CLOSE-UP from the knees down, seen from the side, step edge clearly visible. TOP: right knee straight, heel level with the step. BOTTOM: right knee visibly BENT and pushed forward, heel sunk below the step edge. The bent knee is the key difference from a straight-knee calf stretch.

naam: Kuitrek gebogen knie – staand met steun
pose_en: She stands facing a wall, seen exactly from the side: we see her from her RIGHT side (she faces the viewer's right), so her right leg is nearest to the viewer, the wall on the viewer's right. Both hands rest flat on the wall at chest height. Her LEFT foot is close to the wall; her RIGHT foot is placed a SMALL step back, flat on the floor. Both knees are straight and her body is upright. The arrow is a curved arrow at the front of her right (back) knee pointing FORWARD and DOWN, showing the knees bending while the heel stays down.
eind_en: END position: same side view. BOTH knees are clearly bent and she has sunk a little lower; the back (right) knee is pushed forward and down while the right heel stays FLAT on the floor. Torso upright, hands on the wall.
extra_avatar: Frame both figures from the hips down, seen from the side, wall on the right. TOP: both knees straight. BOTTOM: both knees clearly bent, the back (right) heel still flat on the floor. Exaggerate the knee bend of the back leg.
